title: Crystal and Specimen Registry
negative_results: A registered specimen (metadata only) is never a physical measurement; refuse_specimen_as_measured raises unconditionally on a described specimen.
A NOMINAL, INFERRED or UNKNOWN quantity cannot be read as measured; require_measured raises for anything but MEASURED.
An UNKNOWN quantity carries no value and none can be smuggled in.
promote_to_measured refuses without bound artifacts, refuses a missing dimension, and refuses an unknown mass.
The REAL acquisition mode is BLOCKED_MISSING_INPUT: no hardware or real specimen exists in this environment, so a real physical measurement is blocked, not produced.
A content-hash tamper with any field is detected (verify_record returns False); a record without a hash fails verification.
The (0,0,0) cut plane is refused; an amorphous specimen has no crystallographic lattice frame.
No specimen record reaches a measurement claim class; the strongest is SYNTHETIC_FIXTURE / SYNTHETIC_OBSERVATION / SOURCE_CLAIM.
reopening_test: Reopen P04 if real physical artifacts and a REAL acquisition path become available (hardware present), so that promote_to_measured must produce a PHYSICAL_MEASUREMENT-class record bound to instrument, calibration, fixture, clock, environment and uncertainty per r15.claims; or if the specimen_record schema gains newly required fields not serialized by SpecimenRecord.to_record().

acceptance_checklist.item: r15/specimens.py implemented (typed dataclasses/enums, numpy, hashlib, typed exceptions, deterministic/seeded)
tests/v8/test_specimens.py focused + negative + determinism tests green
Reuses r13.crystalframe for the quartz lattice frame/orientation and r15.claims for the taxonomy; no sibling r15 phase module imported
SpecimenRecord.to_record() conforms to r15/schemas/specimen_record.schema.json (validated with jsonschema)
Registered vs measured distinguished; refuse_specimen_as_measured present; REGISTERED specimen is SOURCE_CLAIM/SYNTHETIC_FIXTURE, never PHYSICAL_MEASUREMENT
REAL/REPLAY/SYNTHETIC/FAULT_INJECTION modes kept distinct; synthetic specimens visibly synthetic
Immutable specimen ids + revision history + content hash with tamper detection
Report carries claim_class, measured_here='nothing', physical_validation, verdict
Receipt conforms to phase_receipt.schema.json (validated with jsonschema)

claims.statement: A typed, immutable, content-hashed specimen registry with revision history and a registered/measured/damaged/quarantined/retired lifecycle was implemented in software.
The alpha-quartz lattice constants a~4.913 A and c~5.405 A and the P3_121/P3_221 space-group pair are CONVENTIONAL_LITERATURE values reused from r13.crystalframe, not measured here.

privacy_check: CLEAN - synthetic fixtures only, no private inputs
